cleavage_agent.evidence: For PSAD (resp. PCVS) samples were digested by trypsin (0.2 μg/μL) in 25mM NH4HCO3 buffer overnight at 37°C.

collision_energy.evidence: For PSAD, fragments were obtained by Higher-energy C-trap Dissociation (HCD) activation with a collisional energy of 27%, and a quadrupole isolation window of 1.6 Da.
